name: DialUpSoundz
tagline: Talk a playlist through with Claude, then save it to Apple Music.
summary: Paste the list Claude gives you. DialUpSoundz finds every song on Apple Music, shows you what it matched, and saves the playlist to your library or plays it right away. That part is free. A one-time Data Layer unlock adds your own record of what you play and what you think of it: ratings, tags and liner notes, recommendations from a Claude Project, and your data to export, all kept on your iPhone.
statusLabel: Coming soon to the App Store
stepsHeading: From a chat to a playlist

steps.title: Talk it through with Claude
steps.body: Copy the DialUpSoundz prompt into a chat with Claude. Talk about moods, eras, deep cuts and what to leave out, then ask for the list.

steps.title: Paste the list
steps.body: Copy Claude's reply and paste it into DialUpSoundz. A plain list such as Artist - Song, one per line, works too.

steps.title: Review the matches
steps.body: Each song, artist or album is looked up on Apple Music. Anything that needs a look is marked, and you can swap versions, preview, reorder or remove.

steps.title: Save
steps.body: Nothing is saved until you tap Save. The playlist goes to your Apple Music library with its name and description.

features.title: Playlists from Claude's list
features.body: Original studio versions are preferred over live, karaoke and cover versions, unless you asked for those. Save it, or play it right here with AirPlay.

features.title: Album lists
features.body: Ask Claude for whole albums instead of songs, and DialUpSoundz matches each one to the album on Apple Music.

features.title: Rate fast
features.body: Work through your most played albums and songs, an artist's records, or anything on Apple Music: stars, love or not, your own tags, and liner notes. With the Data Layer.

features.title: Recommendations from Claude
features.body: Export your ratings and listening to a Claude Project, and ask for music that fits your taste. With the Data Layer.

features.title: Research and notes
features.body: Dig into an album with Claude and keep what you learn with it, along with why Claude recommended it. With the Data Layer.

features.title: Your data, yours to keep
features.body: Browse your listening history, Listen Later and ratings, look inside the JSON, and export all of it. The history and charts are early and growing. With the Data Layer.
